description: This Kotlin source file defines the SearchFragment class, which provides search functionality within a music player app. It handles user input for search queries, uses reactive streams with coroutines to debounce and filter inputs, and updates a RecyclerView with search results obtained from a MusicRepository.

classes.name: SearchFragment
classes.description: A Fragment handling search input and displaying search results for a music player app.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the RecyclerView, adds text change listener to the search input, and manages the search query flow with debounce and filtering.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view binding for the fragment.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears the view binding to prevent memory leaks.
